summary: The task of dataset distillation concerns the learning of a small set of synthetic samples that can serve as an effective replacement for a large real dataset when used for downstream tasks. While many solutions have been proposed since the problem's inception, most of them primarily seek to optimize the distilled data with respect to a classifier.
takeaways: Furthermore, we showcase our method's use as a visualization tool for better interpreting models and extend it beyond images to other modalities.
Our work advances the frontier of dataset distillation, offering a novel synthesis method and proposing distribution-based metrics as a complementary evaluation.
More broadly, our findings help address the growing need to understand both data and models by uncovering more about how they interact.
